selected_primary_idea.title: ODD-Bridge: Operational Design Domain Bridging with Assurance, Recovery, and Legitimacy Evidence
selected_primary_idea.summary: A staged ADS mobility scaling protocol in which each declared ODD expansion must close technical, degraded-mode, mixed-traffic, connected-infrastructure, safety-case, monitoring, and public-governance evidence.
selected_primary_idea.scientific_object: ADS service x ODD card x traffic-mix card x degradation card x connectivity card x recovery card x evidence card x public/governance card
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: ODD-specific assurance gates support more credible scaling decisions than aggregate deployment metrics or component benchmarks.

competitive_ideas.title: Infrastructure-first connected corridor
competitive_ideas.reason: may enhance service in a bounded corridor but cannot replace autonomous degradation handling

high_risk_ideas.title: Human-handoff-first transition
high_risk_ideas.reason: may be valid for some conditional automation but carries attention and transition risks and cannot cover driverless operation

rejected_ideas.reason: component performance alone does not establish ODD transfer, safe fallback, social legitimacy, or city-wide readiness
